mapper.select: SELECT co.id as offering_id, co.course_catalog_id, co.teacher_id, co.academic_year, co.semester, co.course_day, co.course_time, cc.name as course_name, cc.course_code, cc.credits, t.name as teacher_name, oml.course_type, m.id as major_id, m.name as major_name FROM course_offerings co JOIN course_catalogs cc ON co.course_catalog_id = cc.id LEFT JOIN teachers t ON co.teacher_id = t.id LEFT JOIN offering_major_links oml ON co.id = oml.course_offering_id LEFT JOIN majors m ON oml.major_id = m.id WHERE co.id = #{id}

SELECT co.id as offering_id, co.course_catalog_id, co.teacher_id, co.academic_year, co.semester, co.course_day, co.course_time, cc.name as course_name, cc.course_code, cc.credits, t.name as teacher_name, oml.course_type, m.id as major_id, m.name as major_name FROM course_offerings co JOIN course_catalogs cc ON co.course_catalog_id = cc.id LEFT JOIN teachers t ON co.teacher_id = t.id LEFT JOIN offering_major_links oml ON co.id = oml.course_offering_id LEFT JOIN majors m ON oml.major_id = m.id ORDER BY co.academic_year, co.semester, co.course_day, co.course_time

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO course_offerings(course_catalog_id, teacher_id, academic_year, semester, course_day, course_time) VALUES (#{courseCatalogId}, #{teacherId}, #{academicYear}, #{semester}, #{courseDay}, #{courseTime})
